title: Human-Preterm-Cerebellum: analysis code for "Intrinsic Gestational Timing Governs Human Cerebellar Development After Preterm Birth"
description: Analysis code for the manuscript "Intrinsic Gestational Timing Governs Human Cerebellar Development After Preterm Birth" (Sanidas, Simonti et al.). Includes the CoGAPS, Tricycle, LinearModel and LDSC analysis pipelines plus per-figure and per-table reproduction code (figures/, tables/) with rendered HTML reports and PDF panels. Subject-level data are provided with the article as Data S1 to S5.
